text:
Sarah (sales): FYI — Acme Health wants a POC but their vendor-risk team is asking for a full data flow diagram, a subprocessor disclosure, and CAIQ snippets showing encryption/KMS. They require EU-only processing for PHI during the trial. Demo scheduled Fri. Can someone own the artifacts?

Josh (solutions): Copy. Do we offer an EU-only hosted option for POC or should we recommend Dedicated/Private? They specifically asked about customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). @Megan (secops) any quick callouts?

Megan (secops): We can do EU-only in 2 ways: 1) Hosted with strict routing to eu regions + processing pinning (less guarantees), 2) Dedicated capacity or Private deployment (customer data stays in their VPC/region). For KMS: we support customer-managed keys in Private and Dedicated (bring-your-own KMS via KMS/HSM). I have a CAIQ excerpt and a subprocessor list. Posting links: https://redwood.internal/security/caqi-excerpt (internal) and https://redwood.internal/subprocessors.csv (internal) :mag_right:

Tom (arch): Quick ascii DFD so you can paste into the risk pack — will refine in Confluence later:````
Client browser (EU) -> Edge CDN (Fastly, eu) -> Redwood API (eu-cluster)
Redwood API -> Inference nodes (dedicated-gpu-eu)
Model artifacts -> Object storage (AWS eu-west-1)
KV cache -> Redis Enterprise (eu-central)
Audit logs -> Logging provider (Elastic Cloud, eu)
Key material -> Customer KMS (BYOK) / or Redwood KMS (eu)
Third-party telemetry -> Sentry (eu)
Data residency: all PII stays in eu-* regions when pinned.````

InfraBot: Canonical subprocessor spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/subprocessors.csv (latest revision 2026-01-12). Use that for vendor-risk exports. :robot_face: :white_check_mark:

Josh (solutions): Thanks — from pricing perspective: POC expected ~5k inference requests/day, short context lengths. If they want Dedicated EU pinning + BYOK, estimate delta vs hosted = +35% on unit price for the trial. Sarah, we should confirm commit/term to firm up numbers.

Megan (secops): For the CAIQ bits, the customer usually asks specifically for: encryption in transit (TLS v1.2+), encryption at rest (AES-256), KMS key ownership, access control (RBAC + SSO), logging retention, and incident response SLA. I'll drop sanitized control snippets they can include in the questionnaire.

Sarah (sales): Perfect. Action items: (1) Tom — push a prettier DFD to Confluence and share link here (2) Megan — paste the CAIQ snippets we can attach (3) Josh — draft rough POC pricing uplift for Dedicated/BYOK. I'll send the POC scoping doc to Acme risk and cc legal.

Tom (arch): Will add the Confluence diagram in ~30m: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/DFD-ACME-POC (private link) — includes layer showing which subprocessors touch logs vs inference payloads.

Megan (secops): CAIQ snippets — pasteable text for the risk team: "Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced; mutual TLS optional for private deployments. Encryption at rest: customer-managed keys supported via BYOK; default is AES-256. Access control: SSO via SAML/OIDC, RBAC, and per-team API keys. Logging: audit logs retained for 90 days by default, extendable for Enterprise plans. Incident response: 24/7 incident triage + 72-hour initial RCA for Sev 1."

Josh (solutions): For the POC pitch, recommend Dedicated with geo pinning (fastest path to satisfy assurance). I'll cobble together a short price note and drop into the doc.

Sarah (sales): Great — I'll route the Confluence + subprocessor csv to Acme. If they need an attestation or a signed subprocessor list, ping Legal, otherwise we can send the exported CSV and CAIQ snippets.

InfraBot: Export of subprocessor CSV attached to message (rev 2026-01-12).

Sarah (sales): Thanks everyone — please thumbs-up when you’ve finished your item. :thumbsup:

Tom (arch): ✅ done (diagram uploaded).

Megan (secops): ✅ CAIQ snippets posted and I attached sanitized SOC/ISO references.

Josh (solutions): ✅ pricing note added to the POC doc.

Sarah (sales): Closing loop — I'll update the customer and attach these artifacts. If Acme asks for a formal security questionnaire response, I'll create a SIG/CAIQ pull request and tag you for review.

Megan (secops): Sounds good. If they require an independent DATAFLOW diagram for their vendor team (PDF), I can export the Confluence page and redline any vendor names.

Sarah (sales): Perfect — will escalate if they ask for anything else. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
